1. (Currently amended) A compound of formula (IIa) O NaO OR2 O (IIa), in which substituent R2 is selected from the group consisting of alkyl, aryl, and arylalkyl, __wherein the compound exhibits a specific enolate reactivity profile distinct from corresponding potassium enolates in nucleophilic addition reactions to α,β-unsaturated carbonyl compounds__.

2. (Currently amended) A compound according to Claim 1 of formula (IIa) in which R2 is C1-C12-alkyl, C6-aryl, or arylalkyl, __wherein R2 is not ethyl__.

3. (Currently amended) A compound according to Claim 1 of formula (IIa) in which R2 is methyl.

4. (Currently amended) A compound of formula (IIb) O ZO OMe O O (IIb) in which substituent Z is selected from the group consisting of alkali metals and alkaline earth metals, __wherein Z is sodium and the compound is prepared by a method comprising deprotonation of the corresponding β-keto methyl ester with sodium hydride in a non-protic solvent__.

5. (Currently amended) A compound according to Claim 4 of formula (IIb) in which Z is sodium.
